name: Biophysics PhD (direct-entry route)
detailsNote: Official annual priority dates available; Fall 2027 doctorate deadline year not confirmed. Central December 4 is earlier than department December 5. Admission model unconfirmed for direct entry.

publishedDeadlines.label: Central doctorate priority
publishedDeadlines.note: All-doctorate annual date; use earlier than departmental December 5 and confirm intended cycle.

applicationFee.note: Within three years: MCW research participation, GRE reduction eligibility, MCW graduate fair, or conference attendance plus presentation. Indicate category in application; verification may be required. No financial-hardship waivers; international qualification must be confirmed.

english.toefl: 100 recommended legacy score; new-scale recommendation not established
english.note: Recommendations, not hard minima; tests valid up to two years. US-based non-online study or primary-English instruction may support exemption; written request and proof after application, not automatic overseas MOI waiver.

documents: All-institution transcripts (unofficial review permitted generally; official before offer)
Personal statement (valued by program; application may specify format)
Recommendations submitted directly by referees; count not established
International official records, graduation proof and English translations
Credential evaluation: Requirements page requires foreign-coursework evaluation, while admissions FAQ exempts most programs; confirm Biophysics rule
requirements.note: Bachelor degree required, ideally GPA 3 or higher; physics/mathematics competence for direct MRI/instrumentation route, with broad science backgrounds considered. Research experience strongly considered. Molecular biophysics generally uses IDP/MSTP. Prior faculty contact or secured mentor not required by central FAQ; no direct-entry rotation model established.

funding.note: All full-time degree-seeking PhDs in good academic/professional standing receive full tuition, yearly stipend and health insurance from enrollment through completion; no separate funding process. Published $36,355 is historical 2025–26, not a Fall 2027 rate.
